title: Performance notes
intro: Record warnings, compliments, reviews, and incidents on employee files.

sections.title: Performance list
steps: Browse notes by employee, type, and severity.
Add entries after incidents or scheduled reviews.
sections.caption: Performance notes tab.

sections.title: Performance note form
steps: Choose employee, type, title, and body text.
Set severity for incidents and warnings.
Toggle visible to employee if staff may view the note in self-service.
Save to append the note to the HR file.
sections.caption: Performance note form.

fields.name: Content
fields.effect: Full narrative of the event or review.

fields.name: Severity
fields.effect: Low, medium, high, or critical — mainly for warnings and incidents.

fields.name: Visible to employee
fields.effect: When enabled, the note may be shown to the employee user.
